character.name: Idle
character.prompt: > Dark fantasy werewolf, full body, large and muscular humanoid wolf creature with an aggressive and predatory appearance. Tall, broad-shouldered body covered in coarse dark gray and brown fur, with patches of lighter fur around the chest and face. Long wolf-like snout, sharp exposed fangs, pointed ears, deep-set yellowish eyes and a feral expression. > > The creature should have long muscular arms, oversized clawed hands, powerful legs and large animal-like feet. Its posture is slightly hunched forward, emphasizing speed and physical strength rather than intelligence or discipline. The silhouette should feel significantly larger and more threatening than the human knight. > > Wearing only remnants of the clothing it had before transforming: torn dark trousers, ripped leather belts and small pieces of damaged fabric hanging from the waist or shoulders. Very little armor, possibly a broken leather bracer or a single damaged metal plate still attached to one arm. Most equipment should appear destroyed by the transformation. > > No weapons. The werewolf fights entirely with its claws, teeth and physical strength. Add small scars, damaged fur and signs of previous battles to reinforce its savage nature. > > The overall design should communicate a powerful mid-tier monster: physically stronger and more intimidating than the knight, but still a largely natural creature compared to the supernatural enemies that follow. Dark medieval fantasy aesthetic, muted dark gray, brown and black color palette. No magic effects, no glowing aura. 16-bit pixel art RPG character, clear readable silhouette, detailed sprite, neutral aggressive combat-ready pose.
